# Reglet

> .NET 10 library that creates, reads and converts DOCX, ODT, PDF and HTML documents from one format-neutral model, with no dependencies beyond the base class library.

- Install: `dotnet add package Reglet` (facade). `Reglet.Core`, `Reglet.Docx`, `Reglet.Odt`, `Reglet.Pdf`, `Reglet.Html`, `Reglet.Fonts` and `Reglet.Hyphenation` can be used on their own.
- Build a document with `PortableDocument.Create()`, write it with `DocumentWriter.WriteAsync(document, "out.pdf")` (format from the extension), read one with `DocumentReader`.
- Documents are immutable; all lengths are stored in points (`Length`).
- Unicode text in PDF needs caller-provided TrueType fonts (`PdfWriteOptions.FontCollection`).

## Docs
